prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit, immutable canonical faces. First inputs canonical identity portraits, next room reference only, LAST exact target. Preserve people, adult age, exact face morphology, expressions, hair, signature equipment, natural warm skin, whole poses, two connected arm chains per person, grips, neck alignment, chairs and contacts. Farah lens anatomical LEFT, Demir comms anatomical RIGHT. Narrative crew action stays dominant. All unmentioned monitors and wrist displays OFF, plain charcoal glass. No arbitrary waveforms, charts, code, meters or data. Restrained sage, aged brass, charcoal. Eliminate neon mint outlines and broad yellow wash. Any LAB PILLAR dark muted sage with thin dim grey internal bands, never fluorescent lime. Preserve Demir leaning forward, open questioning hand, other hand touching tablet, and Farah crossed arms with stylus raised. Keep every shoulder-arm chain clear. Farah complete head may reduce only subtly, about5 percent, with exact morphology and short natural neck; Demir head unchanged. Main board replaces all arbitrary waveforms/bars with two outlined boxes side by side: "Input: 11 features" and "Rebuilt: 11 features". Both feed a third empty-result box below labeled "Difference: pending". No numbers inside the input boxes and no claim of known signal shape. Demir tablet shows only "Measure MSE" and "Score: pending". No anomaly verdict. Every other screen off; tablet border thin muted sage. Clean bold adventure-comic linework, flat cel shading, balanced stylized adults. Output one 1536x1024 scene.
